【原视频简介】
These chicken cutlets come out golden and crispy, and they're made entirely in the air fryer.

I'll walk you through how to make cutlet in air fryer from start to finish — mixing, shaping, and setting the right time and temperature. If you've been looking for how to make crispy chicken in air fryer, this is a reliable method.

Ingredients:

1 lb/500g chicken breast
5 oz/150g sweet corn
1 oz/30g cheese 
1 egg
3 oz/ 90g greek yogurt
1 oz/ 30g rice flour
1/4 cup diced Scallions
1/3 tsp curry powder
Pepper
Salt

For sauce:

1/2 cup/100g greek yogurt
1/3 tsp oregano
1/3 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp sweet relish
Salt

It's a genuinely easy chicken cutlet recipe and one of the simplest easy chicken air fryer recipe options you can make. Want a cheesy version? This works as a chicken cheese cutlet recipe too.

Why you'll love this:
🐔 Crispy outside, tender inside
🔥 Made in the air fryer — less oil, less mess
💪 High in protein
⚡ Ready fast
📦 Meal-prep friendly

If you're standing in the kitchen wondering what can i make with chicken breast, this is a solid answer. It's one of the better chicken breast recipes for dinner and works as a chicken breast recipe for weight loss — protein-heavy and light on calories.

This chicken cutlet in air fryer is great for easy weeknight chicken nights and fits right into quick and budget-friendly 15-minute recipes.
